model_adaptation: Cached Qwen3-VL-4B, not original VideoChat2 or VILA checkpoint
keyframe_rule: ref42 section3.2: k=scene_count,contiguous equal clusterID runs within each scene, min SSD within run; first-frame SSD=inf
calibration_frame_rule: earliest selected keyframe by source PTS; frozen before any model request
verification_scope: global FSG before merging; object composite prompt from Supplement; attr/relation literal-claim prompts reconstructed from body coverage, reported separately

deprecated_groups.historical_raw_B1_B2: deprecated, no G_raw in current plan

recovery_policy: reuse V1 semantic prefixes; exact native extraction per literal sentence on text overflow; image narrative cap8192; changed suffix regenerated
timeout_policy: 420s future requests; previous4096timeout retained terminal; no retry timedout request
vote_acceptance: strict majority >5/10; ties, invalid responses and insufficient consensus abstain; adaptation
vote_normalization: NFKC/lower/whitespace/terminal punctuation only, lists sorted; no semantic model clustering

historical_group_definitions.B0: Video-Zero majority vote on same frozen video/question
historical_group_definitions.B1: STEP G_step plus deterministic program answer, includes native verification
historical_group_definitions.B2: Same G_step/question/program/B1 answer, additional VQS-style dependency verification, accept/abstain only

groups.S0: S frozen questions / official Video-Zero v4 majority
groups.S1: STEP native graph-guided QRA refined frozen answer
groups.S2: S1 frozen answer / extra VQS-style accept-abstain
groups.P0: P frozen questions / official Video-Zero v4 majority
groups.P2: P1 frozen answer / extra VQS-style accept-abstain
